issue.title: Agent-sync full-sync materialization check misses family-lane pages
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead sase-fa.4 (epic sase-fa) as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP; verified independently by the sase-fa land agent and NOT caused by that epic (the predicate predates it, introduced by 447d96e09 'fix(agents): recover historical sidecar publications (sase-91.6)', and sase-fa left it untouched).

src/sase/agents_sync/git_sync.py::_publication_request_materialized resolves exactly one path:

    agents_root = (target.sidecar_path / 'agents').resolve(strict=False)
    page = (agents_root / global_agent / 'README.md').resolve(strict=False)
    return page.is_relative_to(agents_root) and page.is_file()

A family-lane hood does not publish there. src/sase/agents_sync/rendering.py:88 and publication_validation.py:149 write a family container to 'families/{global_name}.md', so for a hood such as bbugyi200.athena.t2 or bbugyi200.athena.sase-ez.2 the agents/<name>/README.md probe always misses.

Impact: in _sync_project's post-sync reconciliation (git_sync.py around lines 106-131), a non-materialized request is not acknowledged; instead update_agent_publications records the error 'published agent page for <name> did not materialize during full sync' and increments attempts against quarantine_threshold. Every family-lane publication therefore accrues an attempt on every subsequent full sync until it is quarantined, even though its page was published and pushed successfully. sase-fa.4 observed this live on gh_sase-org__sase: both family pages existed and were present at origin/main, yet the outbox kept flagging them. The same failure signature is still visible today in the bob-cli outbox (~/.sase/projects/gh_bobs-org__bob-cli/agents-publication-outbox.json holds a request whose last_error is exactly 'published agent page for bbugyi200.athena.sase-ez.4 did not materialize during full sync', quarantined at 3 attempts).

Scope: teach the materialization probe the same page-path resolution the renderer uses (agents/<global_agent>/README.md for a plain agent, families/<global_name>.md for a family container, and whatever clan containers resolve to), so a published family-lane page is acknowledged instead of penalized. Cover a family-lane hood, a plain agent hood, and a genuinely missing page in tests.
